description: 臺中市降雨淹水潛勢圖、模擬圖 [flood and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府水利局. 本市短延時強降雨條件下之可能積水範圍、可能積水深度。 本圖資係基於設計降雨條件及特定年份地形資料下，運用客觀水理模式經數值模擬演算而得。 由於實際降雨在空間分布上因地形效應及當時大氣條件而極度不均勻，且氣象及水文條件具不確定性，故本圖資無法模擬未來單一颱洪事件之實際淹水狀況，參考使用時應特別留意此情形。 另依經濟部「水災潛勢資料公開辦法」... Coverage: 臺中市政府水利局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府水利局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
